description_en: Creates a Layer 7 forwarding rule by calling CreateLayer7Rule
name: CreateLayer7Rule

parameters.help_en:
The origin server type. Valid values:

0: IP
1: domain name
parameters.name: rs_type

parameters.help_en:
The JSON string of the Layer 7 rule (Layer7Rule) array. The structure is described as follows:

ProxyRules, Array type, required. An array of rule objects that contains the following elements:
    - ProxyPort, Integer type, required. The protocol port. Valid values: 80, 443.
    - RealServers, []String type, required. The origin servers of the user. Example: 1.1.1.1:443.
ProxyType, String type, required. The protocol type. Valid values: http, https, websocket, websockets
parameters.help_zh:
传入7层规则Layer7Rule数组JSON串。具体结构描述如下：

ProxyRules，数组类型，必选，规则对象数组，包含以下元素：
    - ProxyPort，Integer类型，必选，协议端口，取值：80、443。
    - RealServers，[]String类型，必选，用户源站。例如，1.1.1.1:443。
ProxyType，String类型，必选，协议类型，取值：http、https、websocket、websockets
parameters.name: rules

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID to attach. If you have multiple instances, pass in InstanceIds.1, InstanceIds.2, InstanceIds.3, and so on.

If you do not specify this parameter, only the domain name is added without being attached to a specific IP address
parameters.help_zh:
要绑定的实例ID。若有多个实例，依次传入InstanceIds.1, InstanceIds.2, InstanceIds.3, ..

若不传入该参数，则只添加域名，不绑定到具体IP
parameters.name: instance_ids
